skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the main points of short conversations or monologues with diverse content.
Present a 2-3 minute independent speech on basic, familiar topics in daily life.
Read and understand short articles or passages about common topics.
Write emails or short letters about common topics in daily life.
Apply grammar rules in writing and speaking.
Expand vocabulary through reading and writing exercises.
Develop self-study habits including reading, pronunciation practice, sentence formation, and writing short paragraphs.
Participate in online learning activities to reinforce classroom learning.
Analyze and interpret information from texts and discussions.
Engage in group discussions and collaborative problem-solving.
